subject: AWS Marketplace compatibility matrix + copy polish for product page
messages:
From: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@acmeretail.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS listing compatibility matrix + product page copy

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. We’re close to the internal procurement checklist and have two asks before we slot your listing for the June catalog push: a compatibility matrix that confirms region/AMI/instance parity and a quick polish pass on the product hero + brief usage examples for our field.

Specifically:
- Which AWS regions will have parity at launch? (us-east-1/us-west-2/ eu-west-1 etc.)
- Is the AMI single-arch or multi-arch? Any special kernel modules or init steps we need to call out?
- Do you support BYO-key (KMS) for customers on Dedicated mode?
- Suggested hero one-liner and 2 short usage bullets that will fit the tile.

I attached a template (compatibility-matrix-v1.xlsx) and a rough hero we mocked up. Can you confirm by end of day Friday PST? If easier, happy to take a 30-min call Thursday morning to walk through.

Attachments: compatibility-matrix-v1.xlsx, hero-draft.pdf

Best,
Samantha Lopez
Head of Cloud Procurement
Acme Retail
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS listing compatibility matrix + product page copy

Hi Samantha — great to hear. We can definitely get this over. I filled the matrix with our current plan and added notes for known gaps (see compatibility-matrix-v1.xlsx). High level:

- Regions: GA in us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1. Planned rollout to ap-southeast-1 in Q3.
- AMI: multi-arch (x86_64 + arm64). No special kernel modules; customer init is standard cloud-init. I added a note about instance profile permissions required for S3/KV cache prewarm.
- BYO-key: supported for Private and Dedicated via customer KMS; Hosted requires tokenized access but we can support envelope encryption on request (ops + compliance review).

For hero copy, suggested 1-line and two bullets attached in product-hero-copy-v2.md. Short version: "Predictable LLM inference at enterprise scale — fast, cost-efficient, and deployable in your VPC."
Bullets (2):
• Dedicated GPU pools with SLA-backed latency
• Unified API across hosted, dedicated and private deployments

Quick ask: can you confirm whether Acme requires GovCloud/GovCloud region (we currently don’t support govcloud in GA)? If yes, we’ll flag as an exception for procurement.

I can do the call Thu 10:00-10:30 PT to walk through; Marissa and Jonas are looped for copy and partner ops notes.

Attachments: compatibility-matrix-v1.xlsx (updated), product-hero-copy-v2.md

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Goal: lock the matrix + final copy by Friday so procurement can push the listing to staging next week.

Subject: Re: AWS listing compatibility matrix + product page copy

Quick technotes after reviewing the matrix:

1) AMI init steps: confirm cloud-init user-data script will create the inference user and download KV cache from S3. We should add a note about IAM role scoping: minimum s3:GetObject for the bucket and sts:AssumeRole for cross-account prewarm.
2) Multi-arch: our binaries are packaged for x86_64 and arm64; scale tests show parity for latency within 10% on the same instance class. I added a row in the matrix with test date and sample latency numbers.
3) KMS: BYO-key works for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted customers we only support customer-managed keys in the private deployment path; for marketplace listing we should call out: "Encryption at rest with customer-managed KMS available in Dedicated/Private deployments" — keeps expectations correct.
4) GovCloud: not supported in GA — flag it as a compliance/region exception (we can propose a dedicated pilot if Acme needs it).

I’ll update the spreadsheet with the IAM bullets and test numbers. Kim, Marissa — happy to join Thu call to walk through the technical rows.

—Aditya
From: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@acmeretail.com>

Subject: Re: AWS listing compatibility matrix + product page copy

Thanks team — this is perfect. We reviewed the updated matrix and hero copy. A couple of quick items before procurement closes the ticket:

• Please shorten the hero one-liner to 110 characters for the AWS tile (Marissa — that’s yours).
• Add the explicit KMS sentence to the listing as Aditya suggested.
• We do not need GovCloud for launch; good to know as a future pilot.

We’ll schedule the DocuSign step for the marketplace agreement next week — I’ll send the link once procurement routes the paperwork. Call Thursday at 10:00 PT works; confirm calendar invite and we’ll take the final pass then.

Best,
Samantha

Acme Retail
